d: We are seeking an Accountant to join Reneco’s Finance team in Abu Dhabi. The Accountant will handle daily accounting activities and support financial closing, reporting, and audits, ensuring accurate records and proper supporting documentation.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
Minimum of five years of relevant accounting experience.
Good knowledge of accounting principles and practical experience in bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial closing.
Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger entries.
Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel for reconciliations and reporting.
Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and ability to meet deadlines.
Good communication skills, a collaborative approach and discretion with confidential information.
Previous accounting experience in the UAE.
Experience working in an international or multi-entity organisation.
Experience supporting audits and preparing VAT-related accounting records.
Knowledge of French or Arabic would be an advantage.

Mondelēz International in the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan serves the Middle East and Africa markets as well as Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada. We are market leaders in key snacking categories with iconic global and local brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Milka, Oreo and belVita biscuits, Barni Cakes,Tang powdered beverage, Chiclets and Trident gum and Halls candy.
